name: clubedarifa-backend
description: Clube da Rifa - backend: API HTTP, worker e banco. Fonte versionada dos contratos.

scripts.prepare:internal: npm run build -w @clubedarifa/shared && npm run build -w @clubedarifa/db && npm run build -w @clubedarifa/logging && npm run build -w @clubedarifa/psp && npm run build -w @clubedarifa/billing && npm run build -w @clubedarifa/payment-accounts
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:internal && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.dev:api: npm run prepare:internal && npm run dev -w @clubedarifa/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run prepare:internal && npm run dev -w @clubedarifa/worker
